clues: This town is the chief town of its province, and its most peopled town, yet the least by land. It is one of two hub towns of its isle lands.
Rain rules from June to November here; dry days rule from December to May. The hot peak comes in April and May, at the dry time's end.
This town is best known for its great school of high learning. It was the first of its faith and its far shore land in all of Asia.
Folk call this a town of schools: four great schools of high learning stand here. Their halls draw the young from all the isles.
This town's power comes from an earth-heat plant in the next town up the hill. Steam from the ground lights its streets.
